note: Read on 2026-11-14. Transcribed by an AI session under D34 of issue #77. Verbatim text to compare: «T¶ Brunosol» μ … «0.0300» (column K_Puentes). This is the MEAN of the class (n = 26; standard deviation σ = 0.0110), not the K of one soil. How the class is turned into the K of the field is an open decision. Table 1 header, read in the PDF: the label «mg kg-1» is printed directly under «K_Puentes‡» (second header row), and the columns Ca to «Sum of Bases» have no label of their own; the text of p. 105 says «All K-values were expressed in compatible SI units, i.e., in (t ha h)(ha MJ mm)-1». Recorded as a note, not corrected (D70). The string accepted by D11 is `t ha h ha-1 MJ-1 mm-1`. Range μ ± σ per D70 (issue #77). Scope set to {} because EP1 looks K up with the empty scope (SOIL_LOSS.md). Soil of the demonstration point decided by the lead developer in D112 of issue #77 (2026-11-14): one soil, the Brunosol eutrico tipico of the Unidad del Lago at La Estanzuela, the soil of the accepted water profile (USER-AE; Capurro 2016, pp. 43 and 46); its class in S9 Table 1 is 'T Brunosol' (S9: 'T is typical'), so the class and K of D100 are unchanged and D100's vertic limit no longer applies. K is the class mean, not a measurement at the site. Unit string set to «t ha h ha-1 MJ-1 mm-1» (the string of D11 that EP1 accepts; M1.7 asks the lead developer to confirm the published unit); the source prints «(t ha h)(ha MJ mm)-1». Checked by the lead developer (gbarbozamar) in the session chat on 2026-11-14 against a crop of the source page (D34, D66). Value selected for the demonstration point La Estanzuela (D83 for R, D100 for K); scope {} is PROPOSED until EP1 reads a site scope.
